implementation.request_context: RequestContextMiddleware emits JSON request.completed/request.failed/request.rejected records with timestamp, level, service, event, trace_id, request_id, project_id, episode_id, shot_id, job_id, attempt_id, worker_id, provider, method/path and duration/status context.
implementation.safety: Only bounded identifier values are accepted; request bodies, query strings, authorization headers and exception messages are never logged. X-Trace-Id is echoed for local correlation.
implementation.existing_task_log_api: Persistent job attempt logs remain available through GET /api/v1/job-attempts/{attempt_id}/logs; this change does not mutate job state.
